entries.reason: Vulnerable copy is reached only through apps/web's build-time-only @tanstack/react-start-plugin (already the newest version published — no fix exists to upgrade to). The actual runtime framework, @tanstack/react-start, resolves its own separately-patched copy; apps/web/src has no createServerFn usage. See docs/TRACKING.md for the full trace.

Reached only through packages/db's drizzle-kit -> the deprecated @esbuild-kit/core-utils (merged into tsx upstream). Requires exposing esbuild's own dev server, which nothing in this repo does; drizzle-kit is a local-only migration CLI, never deployed. A narrow overrides pin was tried and confirmed not to work (two syntaxes, each verified with a clean reinstall). See docs/TRACKING.md for the full trace.
